# `aube ignored-builds`

- **Usage:** `aube ignored-builds [-g --global]`
- **Effect:** read-only

Print packages whose install scripts were skipped by the `allowBuilds` allowlist

## Flags
- **`-g --global`** — Operate on globally-installed packages instead of the current project.
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
